scope: Fish R012 receipt lineage; possible later reuse for multi-step publication receipts
trigger: A tested implementation is followed by receipt or task-anchor commits before audit or delivery.
requiredInputs: complete changed-path set from tested subject
gate: The tested subject must be an ancestor of the receipt/head.
The receipt must bind the exact tested subject and run/job evidence.
Every descendant change must be inside the explicit metadata allowlist.
Any runtime, source, workflow, public artifact, or unrelated policy delta requires a new test or HOLD.
Human and machine claims must name the tested subject; a mutable branch head cannot inherit the word tested.

terminalAttempt.failedStep: All-preset browser, exports, real source regeneration and mobile layout

evidenceUpdates.novelty: NO_NOVELTY; native generation and card enumeration cannot transfer tested status to a failed browser-regenerated subject or to an unexecuted public delivery

activation.rollback: Do not activate; retain current R2 and require exact tested implementation SHA.
